sources.title: FollowMe August 2025 GPS — Maldives Datathon 2026 release v1.0
sources.publisher: FollowMe / Maldives Bureau of Statistics datathon repository
sources.licence: Participant download; explicit redistribution licence unstated

method.grain: Island/day tracked-device presence; one device can visit multiple islands
method.timezone: Undocumented; source clock retained without UTC conversion
method.spatial_match: Inside or approximately 500 m from exactly one valid island polygon
method.projection: Equirectangular metres at latitude 4.5 degrees; approximate radius
method.privacy: Aggregate counts only; identities, tracks and mobile fields omitted
method.daily_coverage: Island daily arrays omit dates with no matched records

limitations: Historical recorded presence; not live positions, sailings, demand or crowding.
Stationary reports included. Counts can reflect reporting frequency, not activity.
Limited device coverage. Missing records do not establish an absence of boats.
Devices can visit multiple islands; island device totals are not additive.
Overlapping matches excluded. A 500 m association is not a proven port call.
Clock timezone and speed units undocumented. Speeds and journey calibration not used.
